resources.string: One alert each morning, when the new issue is out.

The app can tell you each morning when the new issue is out. It checks around 7:00, Spanish mainland time, and, if it is not out yet, every 15 minutes until 9:30; Android may delay it a few minutes to save battery. To do this, your phone only checks the paper\'s website: it sends nothing to anyone.
Alerts are on: each morning, when the new issue is out, you get a notification. It checks around 7:00, Spanish mainland time, and, if it is not out yet, every 15 minutes until 9:30.
Without permission to show notifications, the app cannot alert you. You can allow it in Android settings.
